race.description: Agristorage And Logistics Moree Cup Hcp
race.comment: HIBIKI HARMONY (6) was prominent at the corner and progressed nicely last start to finish a close second over 1500m at Tuncurry. Doesn't have to raise the bar much here to strike through back to a winning trip. AWAYGOESTHEBUNNY (10) flashed home into third over this distance at Casino two runs back then closed off okay fifth las time after settling a mile off them. Drawn much kinder this time and if Looker can utilise it he's right up to this. CONCOCTION (15) was in the money over this journey two back then failed at the longer trip last time at Randwick. Can bounce back. DON PEDRO (12) is knocking on the door and doesn't need to improve much down at this weight to be threatening on the quick back-up. VORACIOUS (1) was less effective in town last time after getting the bob at Forbes the run before. Boasts a strong record over this trip and is worth keeping safe.
